spans.s:
स्पन्द् स्पन्द् (sometimes incorrectly con-
founded with rt. स्यन्द्), cl. 1. A. स्पन्-
दते, पस्पन्दे, अस्पन्दिष्ट, स्पन्दितुम्, to
quiver, throb, tremble, quake, shake, palpitate, beat,
to go, move (= rt. स्यन्द्): Pass. स्पद्यते (accord-
ing to some), Aor. अस्पन्दि: Caus. स्पन्दयति,
Aor. अपस्पन्दत्.

स्पन्द, अस्, m. throbbing, throb, pulse, tremor,
vibration, motion; [cf. वि-ष्पन्द.]
—स्पन्द-
कारिका, f., N. of a metrical version of the Spanda-
sūtra.
—स्पन्द-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work.
—स्पन्द-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of the aphorisms of
the Śaiva philosophy (= शिव-सूत्र).

स्पन्दन, अम्, n. throbbing, pulsation, palpita-
tion, quivering, (throbbings and quiverings of the
[]
limbs and different parts of the body are supposed by
the Hindūs to indicate good or bad luck; they are
therefore minutely described in certain works);
tremor, vibration, agitation; the quickening of a
child in the womb; rapid motion, going; (according
to some) a car, chariot (Sāy. explains स्पन्दने by
रथस्य गमने सति, Ṛg-veda

); (अस्),
m. a sort of tree.

स्पन्दमान, अस्, आ, अम्, throbbing, quivering,
palpitating, beating; going.

स्पन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, throbbed, quivered, agitated,
throbbing, beating; gone; (अम्), n. a pulsation,
throb.

स्पन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, quivering, throbbing, palpitat-
ing, beating, tremulous.
स्परितृ स्परितृ. See स्पर्ष्टृ, p. 1151.
स्परिश स्परिश. See p. 1151, col. 1.

स्परिश, अस्, m. touch (= स्पर्श below; Śab-
da-k.).

स्पर्ध् स्पर्ध् (connected with rt. स्पृह्,
q. v.; the older form seems to have been
स्पृध्, q. v.), cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) स्पर्धते
(-ति), पस्पर्धे, स्पर्धिष्यते, अस्पर्धिष्ट,
स्पर्धितुम्, to contend or compete with, contest,
vie with, emulate, rival, be equal with; to envy; to
challenge, defy, bid defiance to: Pass. स्पर्धते,
Aor. अस्पर्धि: Caus. स्पर्धयति, Aor. अप-
स्पर्धत्, &c.: Desid. पिस्पर्धिषते: Intens. पा-
स्पर्ध्यते, पास्पर्द्धि; [cf. Goth. spauards;
Old Germ. spurt; Angl. Sax. spyrd.]

स्पर्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, emulous, envious; (आ), f.
emulation, rivalry, competition, the successive eleva-
tion of rivals; envy, jealousy; defiance; equality
with.
—स्पर्ध-ता, f. rivalry, emulation, envious-
ness.
स्पर्धन, अम्, n. competition, emulation; envy.

स्पर्धमान, अस्, आ, अम्, vying, emulating, com-
peting, contending with, envying, challenging, de-
fying.

स्पर्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, contended with, emulated,
envied; defied.

स्पर्धित्वा, ind. having contended or competed
or vied with.

स्पर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, rivalling, emulating, compet-
ing; emulous, envious; proud, superb.

स्पर्धिष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, about to contend
or compete.

स्पर्श् स्पर्श् (also written स्पश्, see rt. 5.
स्पश्; cf. rt. 1. स्पृश्), cl. 10. A. स्पर्-
शयते, अपस्पर्शत, &c., to take, take hold of,
touch (= rt. 1. स्पृश्); to unite, join, embrace.

स्पर्ष् स्पर्ष् (= rt. पर्ष्, q. v.), cl. 1. A.
स्पर्षते, &c., to become wet or moist.
स्पर्श स्पर्श, स्पर्शन, &c. See p. 1151.

स्पर्श, अस्, m. touching, touch, perception by
touch, handling, contact; sexual union; collision, con-
flict, encounter (= सम्-पराय); the quality of tangi-
bility (which is the Viṣaya for the skin; see साङ्-
ख्य); feeling, sensation; anything which touches
or comes in contact, (eleven such Sparśas are enume-
rated, viz. 1. उष्ण, hot; 2. शीत, cold; 3. सुख,
pleasant; 4. दुःख, painful; 5. स्निग्ध, greasy;
6. विशद, clean; 7. खर, hard; 8. मृदु, soft;
9. श्लक्ष्ण, smooth; 10. लघु, light; 11. गुरु,
heavy); who or what affects or acts upon or in-
fluences; affection, morbid affection or influence, any-
thing the contact or influence of which causes pain
or disease, disorder, sickness, fever; air, wind; a
consonant of any of the five classes of Gutturals,
Palatals, Cerebrals, Dentals, and Labials (so called be-
cause the first four are pronounced by the contact of
the tongue with the four places of utterance [see
स्थान, स्पृष्ट], throat, palate, top of palate, and
teeth; the fifth class or labials being formed by contact
of the lips); contact (in astron.); presentation, gift,
donation, offering, (काक-स्पर्श, a particular cere-
mony on the tenth day after a death, putting out a lump
of rice as an offering for the crows); a spy (probably
for स्पश, q. v.); (आ), f. a wanton or unchaste wo-
man.
—स्पर्श-तन्मात्र, अम्, n. the subtile ele-
ment of tangibility, (see साङ्ख्य.)
—स्पर्श-ता,
f. a state of contact, touching.
—स्पर्श-मणि,
इस्, m. ‘touch-stone,’ a kind of stone (supposed to
turn everything it touches to gold), the philo-
sopher's stone.
—स्पर्शमणि-प्रभव, अम्, n.
‘touchstone-production,’ gold.
—स्पर्श-लज्जा, f.
‘shrinking from touch,’ the sensitive plant, Mimosa
Pudica.
—स्पर्श-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having tangi-
bility, palpable; agreeable to the touch, smooth,
soft.
—स्पर्श-वर्ग, अस्, m. a class of consonants,
(see under स्पर्श).
—स्पर्श-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to
be known or apprehended by the sense of touch.
—स्पर्श-शुद्धा, f. ‘pure to the touch,’ the plant
Asparagus Racemosus.
—स्पर्श-सुख, अम्, n. the
pleasure of touch.
—स्पर्श-स्नान, अम्, n. ablution
at the ingress of the sun or moon into an eclipse.
—स्पर्श-स्यन्द, अस्, m. a frog (also written
स्पर्श-स्पन्द).
—स्पर्शानन्दा (˚श-आन्˚), f.
‘touch-delighting,’ N. of an Apsaras.
—स्पर्शोदय
(˚श-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a consonant succeed-
ing, followed by a consonant.

स्पश् 1. स्पश् (= rt. 1. पश्, q. v.), cl. 1.
P. A. स्पशति, -ते, पस्पाश, पस्पशे,
स्पशिष्यति, -ते, अस्पाशीत्, अस्पशिष्ट, स्पशितुम्,
to see, behold, perceive clearly, spy out, espy: Caus.
स्पाशयति, -ते, -यितुम्, Aor. अपस्पशत्, to destroy;
Desid. पिस्पशिषति, -ते: Intens. पास्पश्यते, पा-
स्पष्टि; [cf. Zend śpaś; Gr. σκέπ-τ-ο-μαι, σκοπ-ή,
σκοπιά, σκοπ-ό-ς, ἐπι-σκοπος, σκώψ; Lat. spec-i-o,
con-spic-i-o, specula, speculum, spec-to; Old
Germ. speh-o-m, spāh-i, ‘circumspect, prudent.’]

. स्पल् or स्पट् = स्प्रष्टा = होता, a priest;
in Ṛg-veda
VIII. 61, 15

. स्पट् = सर्वस्य ज्ञाता,
‘omniscient,’ applied to Indra); a ray or rein, (ac-
cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

. स्पशः =
रश्मयः or चराः.)

स्पश् 3. स्पश्, = rt. 3. पश्, ‘to bind,’
q. v. This rt. is said to have the follow-
ing additional meanings — to obstruct, oppose, hinder;
to string together; to touch, undertake, perform,
(Sāy. पस्पशे = स्पृष्टवान् = अनुतिष्ठति, Ṛg-
veda
; अस्पष्ट = उपक्रान्तवान्,
4. स्पश्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. binding.

स्पश् 5. स्पश् (= rt. स्पर्श्), cl. 10. A.
स्पाशयते, &c., to take, &c. See rt.
स्पर्श्.

स्पश, अस्, m. a spy [cf. Old Germ. spëhon, ‘to
look;’ spëhu, ‘a spy’]; any secret messenger or
emissary; a fight, war, battle; a kind of gladiator
who fights with a savage animal for a reward.

स्पष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, clearly perceived or discerned,
distinctly visible, distinct, clear, evident, manifest,
plain, apparent, intelligible; true, real; one who sees
clearly; (अम्), ind. clearly, distinctly; openly, boldly,
(न स्पष्टम् उद्वीक्षते, he does not look [at
me] straight in the face.)
—स्पष्ट-गर्भा, f. a
woman evidently pregnant.
—स्पष्ट-तारक, अस्,
आ, अम्, (the sky) which has its stars distinctly seen
or clearly displayed.
—स्पष्ट-प्रतिपत्ति, इस्, f.
clear perception or ascertainment.
—स्पष्ट-भा-
षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or स्पष्ट-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, speak-
ing clearly or distinctly, plain-spoken.
—स्पष्टार्-
थ (˚ट-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, clear in meaning, obvious,
perspicuous, intelligible.
—स्पष्टी-करण, अम्, n.
the act of making distinct or clear, elucidation.
—स्पष्टी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make dis-
tinct or clear.
—स्पष्टी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made
plain or clear, explained, expounded, elucidated, made
manifest, revealed, exposed.
—स्पष्टी-भूत, अस्, आ,
अम्, become plain or evident.
—स्पष्टेतर (˚ट-
इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, the reverse of clear, indistinct, un-
intelligible.
स्पष्ट स्पष्ट. See above.

स्पष्टय, Nom. P. स्पष्टयति, &c., to make
clear, elucidate.
स्पाशित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be stopped, hindered.
स्पार्ह स्पार्ह. See rt. स्पृह्, p. 1151.

स्पार्ह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. स्पृहा), Ved. wished for,
desirable, agreeable, enviable; (अम्), n., Ved. any-
thing enviable or beautiful, (Sāy. स्पार्हा = स्पृह-
णीयानि तेजांसि, Ṛg-veda

.)
—स्पार्ह-रा-
धस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having or bestowing enviable
wealth, (Sāy. = स्पृहणीय-धन, Ṛg-veda

.)
—स्पार्ह-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having
enviable heroes or posterity.

स्पर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, delivering or protecting from,
a deliverer; [cf. अव-स्प्˚.]

स्पर्शक, अस्, आ, अम्, touching, who or what
touches or comes in contact with, a toucher.

स्पर्शन, अस्, ई, अम्, touching, handling; affect-
ing, acting upon; (अस्), m. air, wind; (अम्), n. the
act of touching, touch, contact; sensation, sense of
touch, organ of sensation or feeling, sensitive nerve;
gift, donation.

स्पर्शनक, अम्, n. ‘that which touches,’ a term
for the skin (in the Sāṅkhya phil.).

स्पर्शनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be touched, percepti-
ble by touch, tangible, sensible, palpable, to be felt,
to be handled.
स्पर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, touching, handling.

स्पर्ष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, tangible, to be felt, to
be handled.

स्पर्ष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, who or what touches or
affects or acts upon; (टा), m. any agent or affection
causing bodily pain or sickness, morbid heat, (the
word स्परितृ given in Śabda-k. appears to be a
corrupt form of this word; cf. स्परिश.)

स्पार्शनप्रत्यक्ष, अम्, n. (fr. स्पर्शन +
प्रत्यक्ष), tactile perception, perception by touch
or feel.
